_schema_note: Append-only. Decision identity is the (category, subject) pair.

decisions.subject: Production pipeline
decisions.selected: Kokoro to measured timing to HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP to HyperFrames and FFmpeg QA
decisions.rejected_because: The brief and authoritative method require the local measured source-code pipeline.

decisions.subject: Explainer shape
decisions.selected: concept explainer with three process steps
decisions.rejected_because: The subject is a method and the brief explicitly asks to teach rather than sell.

decisions.subject: Narration voice
decisions.rejected_because: This is the method default and supports the target script budget.

decisions.subject: Music
decisions.rejected_because: Silence beneath the voice keeps the instructional hierarchy clear.

decisions.subject: Master output
decisions.rejected_because: 1080p is the requested production convention and broadly playable.

decisions.subject: Quality gates
decisions.selected: script lock, measured audio, lint, check, every-scene midpoint inspection, render, ffprobe, loudness and final-frame inspection
decisions.rejected_because: The production contract makes every listed gate mandatory.

decisions.subject: Delivery
decisions.selected: self-contained source production plus one H.264/AAC master
decisions.rejected_because: The brief requires auditable source artifacts and no external runtime dependency.
